card: This PR backports PR #35878 to the 30.x maintenance branch to ensure net_processing only processes unique transaction INVs. Nodes currently expend resources evaluating conflicting or duplicate transaction announcements that cannot both be accepted into the mempool. It applies cleanly without conflicts from master, addressing peer-to-peer transaction relay efficiency.
evidence: Commit 83941a40d1: 'There is no reason we should process conflicting advertisements for transactions, as they cannot be both accepted into our mempool. Avoid processing these and doing spurious work.'
problem: Nodes on the 30.x branch process duplicate and conflicting transaction INVs from peers even though conflicting transactions cannot both enter the mempool, leading to spurious processing overhead.

risk.why: Altering P2P transaction INV processing could inadvertently drop valid transaction announcements or disrupt transaction propagation across peers.

scope_notes: Clean cherry-pick backport of merged PR #35878 into the 30.x release branch.
summary: Backports PR #35878 to the 30.x maintenance branch. It modifies net_processing to only process unique transaction INVs, avoiding redundant work on conflicting transaction announcements.
